status: AdS4, characteristic, canonical and one-loop closure stress test of the claim-1603 isolated 0-minus torsion sector

ads4QuadraticTest.linearIdentity: Xhat^(1)=nabla_mu S^mu remains valid; the dual is a minimally coupled pseudoscalar Klein-Gordon field
ads4QuadraticTest.decision: the flat healthy region has m_0minus^2>0 and therefore lies strictly above the AdS4 BF bound
ads4QuadraticTest.boundaryConditionCaveat: global AdS is not globally hyperbolic without boundary conditions; use an energy-preserving reflecting/standard quantization boundary condition for this positive-mass witness

characteristicAudit.decision: for a_S>0 the dual scalar equation is normally hyperbolic and its characteristic cone is exactly the metric null cone; no superluminal quadratic characteristic is present
characteristicAudit.scope: this does not determine characteristics after other Poincare-gauge invariants are radiatively activated or on a constraint-bifurcation surface

canonicalConstraintAudit.constraintClass: the six constraints are second class when a_S!=0 because {pi^i,C_j}=a_S delta^i_j

singularLimits.a_S=0: the Dirac matrix loses rank; this is lambda=1/4 and the one-mode count cannot be continued through it
singularLimits.b_X=0: pi^0 also becomes constrained and the propagating 0-minus mode disappears

nonlinearConstraintAudit.literatureResult: the massive 0-minus Poincare-gauge mode has normal Hamiltonian propagation, but the full nonlinear scalar-mode theory admits constraint bifurcation on special field/parameter surfaces
nonlinearConstraintAudit.higherSpinWarning: coupling 0-minus to additional higher-spin torsion sectors can activate modes and fail the nonlinear constraint test
nonlinearConstraintAudit.survivingPatch: the quadratic healthy region is admitted only on connected field-space patches where the full Dirac matrix retains its vacuum rank
nonlinearConstraintAudit.decision: quadratic and local canonical viability survives; global nonlinear viability is not proved and rank-changing surfaces are a hard stop

radiativeClosureAudit.spurionStatement: parity, diffeomorphism and local Lorentz invariance allow Xhat^2, C^2, R^2 and the other parity-even curvature/torsion invariants simultaneously; setting all but Xhat^2 to zero restores no symmetry
radiativeClosureAudit.powerCounting: the dimension-four operators are logarithmic counterterm candidates in four dimensions
radiativeClosureAudit.dualPseudoscalarOneLoopDivergence: In a common dimensional-regularization convention, Gamma_div contains [(1/120)C^2-(1/360)E+(1/72)R^2]/[(4pi)^2 epsilon] for one minimally coupled real pseudoscalar, up to total derivatives and mass-dependent lower-dimension terms
radiativeClosureAudit.pgtOneLoopCrossCheck: an explicit Poincare-gauge one-loop calculation by Melichev and Percacci finds that starting with one term of each type generates the other terms and additional operators; their model is not this exact 0-minus truncation, so it is corroboration rather than a beta function for b_X
radiativeClosureAudit.decision: the one-invariant 0-minus surface is not radiatively closed or technically natural
radiativeClosureAudit.unitarityConsequence: if the generated local C^2 term is resummed as a fundamental finite polynomial action with ordinary Feynman poles, the opposite-residue massive spin-2 pole of claim 1599 returns
radiativeClosureAudit.eftQualification: as an EFT, the induced C^2 term is a counterterm and need not be resummed into a physical pole below the cutoff; the healthy 0-minus mode can survive as a low-energy excitation if its mass is below the cutoff

couplings: full Dirac determinant nonzero on the field patch
strongestSurvivingRegion.spectrum: two massless AdS graviton helicities plus one positive-residue gapped 0-minus torsion mode
strongestSurvivingRegion.status: viable classical/low-energy EFT patch, not a radiatively closed fundamental local theory

exhaustionAndStopRules: ADMIT AdS4 quadratic stability when m_0minus^2 ell^2>=-9/4; the positive-mass region passes automatically
ADMIT luminal normal hyperbolicity only while a_S>0 and the isolated scalar principal symbol remains nondegenerate
STOP wherever the nonlinear Dirac matrix changes rank
STOP treating the Xhat^2-only coupling surface as exact under loops: C^2 and R^2 are generated with nonzero coefficients
DO NOT interpret an EFT curvature counterterm as a resolved ghost pole unless the action is extrapolated/resummed beyond its cutoff
A fundamental local completion must enlarge the action and redo every spin-parity residue and constraint test; the minimal surface alone fails that closure requirement
Repeat the calculation with matter couplings and the actual AdS boundary-value problem before phenomenology
decision: The positive 0-minus torsion pole survives AdS4 quadratic stability, luminal hyperbolicity and the local canonical count. It survives as a controlled EFT excitation on constant-rank field patches. The minimal Xhat^2-only action does not survive radiative closure and has known nonlinear constraint-bifurcation boundaries, so it is not yet a fundamental completion.
